email.subject1: a signal play for Energy Exemplar
email.body1:
Mike, saw Energy Exemplar expanded the PLEXOS academic program to grow the next generation of energy-market modelers, on the back of Blackstone and Vista ownership.

Growing the user base usually means more utilities and energy firms in play than the team can cover, and that is where deals stall. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Energy Exemplar off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Mike, quick follow-up for Energy Exemplar.

Under PE ownership, growth targets usually rise faster than headcount can. Most teams cannot say exactly how many meetings they need to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Energy Exemplar needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Mike, last bit of proof for Energy Exemplar.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Energy Exemplar's reply rate likely compares to other enterprise software teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Mike, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. PE-backed growth is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to an enterprise-energy motion? I will tailor it to Energy Exemplar either way.
